explanation: Kublai was Genghis Khan's grandson. He proclaimed the Yuan dynasty in 1271 and built a new capital, Khanbaliq, where Beijing stands.

claims.text: Kublai Khan founded the Yuan dynasty, proclaiming it in 1271, and ruled as emperor of China.
Genghis Khan and Ögedei Khan died before the Yuan dynasty was founded, and Timur never ruled China.
Kublai Khan was a grandson of Genghis Khan.
Kublai Khan built his capital, Khanbaliq, on the site of modern Beijing.
